blocks.text: Three months fresh off the release of his EP ‘A Comedy Romantic (Act.1)’, rising Filipino-American indie pop singer-songwriter Rocco returns with “Someone I Never Had”, an angsty, emotionally charged pop-rock anthem that opens the final chapter of his viral narrative series and sets the stage for the highly anticipated ‘A Comedy Romantic (Act. 2)’. Fans can listen to the new single HERE. Built around the ache of an almost-relationship, “Someone I Never Had” captures a uniquely modern kind of heartbreak: grieving someone who was never truly yours.
